About Higs Multimedia

A design firm built in Kumasi since 2013.

Higs Multimedia is a registered entity that helps businesses, schools, churches and individuals look credible and be remembered. We cover the whole job: the idea, the design, the advertising and the finished print.

The company was established in 2013 by Godfred Osei Kwasi, a KNUST alumnus with a BA in Communication Design. That training shapes how we work: every design starts with who you are talking to and what they need to understand.

Our vision To become the prime among design firms in Ghana.

Services

Four things, done properly.

  • Advertise

    Campaigns that put your name in front of the right people and give them a reason to act.

    Billboards, flyers, posters, banners, pull-up banners and social media adverts.

  • Brand

    An identity that makes your business look consistent everywhere it shows up.

    Logo design, 3D signage, vehicle and T-shirt branding, shop and corporate branding.

  • Consult

    Honest advice before you spend, so your design and print budget goes where it works.

    Brand direction, marketing materials review, design advice and project planning.

  • Print

    Sharp, durable finishes on everything from one business card to a full job lot.

    Posters, banners, pull-up banners, citation and award plaques, labels, cards and brochures.

Our work

What a true brand looks like on paper, cloth and street.

Real jobs we have made for clients across Kumasi and Ghana. Tap any photo to see it larger.

And many more: flyers, brochures, business cards, ID cards, stickers, souvenirs and event materials. Ask us about anything you have in mind.

How it works

From idea to finished job in three steps.

  1. Tell us what you need

    Describe your idea, quantity and deadline by form, call or WhatsApp. You do not need a design file.

  2. Get a clear price

    We review your request and confirm the price with you before any work starts.

  3. Approve, print, collect

    You approve the design, we produce it, and you collect from us or arrange delivery.
